statement: Video shows talent priority rather than a full build; his character is higher level so he has more talent points than the viewer.
Tab 1 priority starts with Gilded Sword for damage to monsters; max it out.
Second priority is Sharpened Axe for weapon power; great early damage increase.
Put at least 50 points into Idle Shooting for about 10% more AFK gain rate while fighting.
Not worth going above 50 Idle Shooting points; at 100 points you only get about 17% AFK gain.
Next priority is Featherweight because a Bowman's main damage comes from movement speed.
Next put points in Quickness Boots or Fist of Rage depending on whether you need accuracy.
If your character already has enough accuracy you can ignore Fist of Rage; you probably need some.
Max Quickness Boots for now and come back to it as more points become available from Tab 3.
With spare talent points max Idle Shooting for the AFK gain rate; not a big priority after 50 points.
Book of the Wise is worth mentioning for damage boost and extra mana so you can use abilities more often.
Lucky Clover is worth mentioning for increased drop rate and EXP gains.
Tab 2 priority: max High Polymer Limbs as soon as possible.
Strafe is next at equal priority since we want as much movement speed as possible; max it for now.
Veins of the Infernal is equal priority to Strafe; gives significant damage based on smithing level.
Hidden offline multiplier based on points in active ability talents; have at least 20-30 points in each of two for more damage or kills per hour offline.
Piercing Arrow gives a bigger boost so maybe only 10 points in Kung Fu Kick and 30 in Piercing Arrow.
Piercing Arrow becomes a lot more useful in active play the higher its level.
Put about 40 points in Have Another! for about a 60% chance to fire an additional arrow.
Next priority is Garb of Un'AGI'ing Quality; scales well and gives more agility from each upgraded equipment piece.
After Garb comes Sanic Speed which is a flat agility increase.
With spare points put into Smeltin' Erryday for much more forging progress and easier gear upgrade materials.
With additional excess points consider Robbinghood for monster drop rarity to get rare items more easily.
Tab 3 priority is always SpeeDNA; more damage based on movement speed.
SpeeDNA gives damage per 15% movement speed above 100% but only at break points; his next is at 190%.
Reaching the next movement speed break point would be significant for him: an additional 39% damage.
Next priority is AGI Again which increases Quickness Boots on Tab 1 even more.
Then Velocity Vessels which raises the level of Featherweight even more.
Velocity Vessels max depends on Archer or Bust bubble level; his bubble is 33 so he puts 33 points.
Next put points in Swifty Statues; the statue speed bonus helps push toward the next break point.
Next priority is Previous Points which lets you put more talent points back into Tab 2 for damage or rarity.
For attack talents put points into Magic Shortbow first; it gives the best AFK kill multiplier.
Also put points in Homing Arrows as one of the top damage abilities.
Active players may want more points in Homing Arrows to make it more equal with Magic Shortbow.
His setup is about 50 points in Magic Shortbow and 20 in Homing Arrows.
Put one point in Flax Instastring to have the Magic Shortbow for active play.
Leftover points go to Shoeful of Obol; damage bonus small but more agility means more movement speed and smithing progress.
Go back to Tab 1 and raise Quickness Boots to the next level to reach 190% for another big damage boost.
With leftover points finish maxing Idle Shooting.
Then Lucky Clover with remaining points for drop rate and EXP gain; this completes the build.

subsystem: Will of the Eldest|Best Beginner Class (star talents)
statement: First star talents: Will of the Eldest and Best Beginner Class as soon as you can; he puts 20 in each.

subsystem: Will of the Eldest|Best Beginner Class (star talents)
statement: Lower highest class levels need fewer points in these two since they are capped by your highest level characters.
Next Attacks on Simmer to boost AFK gains and Tick Tock for more AFK gain rate.
Hemoglobin helps survivability; max it out as soon as you can.
Star Tab 2 priority is Dungeonic Damage; damage based on lifetime dungeon credits earned and need not be held in inventory; max asap.
After Dungeonic Damage go into Frothy Malk for bonuses to foods and potions.
Everything else is optional but he likes Telekinetic Storage for more carry capacity.
He always has one point in Sampling and Shrine Architect so he can place shrines with this character.
Pulsation is a good option for lower level characters to regenerate mana and use attack skills more when active.
Cardiovascular is great for card drop chance.
Just EXP is 100% necessary in his view; more class EXP helps level and get more talent points.
New star talent Tiptoe Quickness is really good for early game archers for movement speed but only effective up to 200% speed.
Tiptoe Quickness will not push you over 200% speed; it only helps until you are above that without it.
Remember to assign your attacks to action bars; Tab 2 has talents to assign including Strafe.
Activate Strafe before going offline; it will not activate automatically.
If Strafe is active before you go offline it stays active until you log back on keeping movement speed up for more damage and kills per hour.
Tab 3 has two more skills to assign to your attack bar plus star talents for carry capacity and printer sampling and shrines.
While attacking use Strafe and assigned movement speed potions for a large speed jump and damage boost; keep refilling them.
Use the Star Talent Reset Potion to instantly reset all talent points if you mess up or after updates.
A star talent reset potion resets only star talents; craftable in Anvil Tab 2 or buyable from the Gem Shop.
